title: OKC drought leads CF short 5d
hypothesis: R2 | [fertilizer-ag] Oklahoma City 20d cumulative precipitation z-score < -1 leads CF log returns by 5 days (-) as drought cuts US nitrogen side-dress demand; short CF 5d [weather.oklahoma_city.precip -> finance.CF.log_return]
message: Noise: OKC precip z>1 -> short CF 2d gives 29 trades, hit 48%, excess +0.3%, sharpe -0.05, OOS 14 trades hit 43%; perm p=0.85, Bonferroni 1.0; actionability 1.99

trade_idea.entry_rule: weather.oklahoma_city.precip rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> short CF next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 2 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [fertilizer-ag] Oklahoma City precipitation 20d z-score > 1 (wet spell, mirror of the drought rule) leads CF log returns by 5 days (+) as rain restores side-dress nitrogen demand; long CF 5d [weather.oklahoma_city.precip -> finance.CF.log_return] (parent: R2-0050)
